text:
Leah CSM: Heads up — Tessera onboarding: saw ~35% token cost increase and p95 latency drift during their peak window. I'm proposing a short pilot: int8 quantized model + route peak traffic to a dedicated pool. Want SRE/Infra + CS alignment before we present this to the customer.

Ken SRE: Can we do a 10% canary for 48h and keep the eval prompt set pinned? Need a quality checklist (sample prompts + pass/fail thresholds). Also confirm fallback policy if quality drops.

Ravi CS: I'll set up the enablement call. Tori, can you share your high-throughput test prompts so we can add them to the eval harness?

Tori (Tessera): Sharing a small corpus now. Main worry is hallucination regressions — what's the typical quality delta with int8 quant?

Nadia Infra: Int8 usually OK, but note: quant swap will invalidate KV caches and cause cold-start tail latency. Suggest a warmup/prefill for top-100 prefixes and a short `no-cache` run to measure baseline. Also check memory headroom for qKV buffers.

Ken SRE: Proposed rollout snippet to run as a canary (we'll instrument dashboards):
```yaml
routing:
  - match: peak_hours
    pool: dedicated-g4dn-small
    weight: 0.1
canary:
  duration: 48h
  traffic: 0.10
  rollback_on: quality_drop>2%
```
We'll capture latency histograms, token cost delta, and exact-match/semantics metrics on the eval set.

opt-bot: perf-report: last 24h p95=310ms; tokens=1.2M; cost_change=+35%. Lab results: candidate `q-llama-13b-int8` shows ~28% token cost reduction and 22% lower p95 in controlled runs.

Leah CSM: Plan: SRE + Infra to run the canary next Tue 09:00 PST, Ravi/Tori to provide prompts and acceptance checklist by Mon EOD. If anyone sees blockers, ping here. :thumbsup: 

Ken SRE: Ack — I'll create dashboards and an alert for quality regressions. @opt-bot can you schedule the post-canary automated eval?

opt-bot: scheduled eval: 2024-11-12T17:00:00Z

Tori (Tessera): Great — I'll deliver prompts and a short acceptance checklist today. Thanks everyone for coordinating.
